subject: Request — OptiCore publicity/exclusivity for renewal concession
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@opticore.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>; procurement@opticore.com
Cc: Emily Wong <emily.wong@opticore.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and reciprocal marketing

Thanks Rafael — we reviewed the renewal terms and appreciate the flexibility on pricing. We'd be willing to commit to a 24-month renewal at the 25% concession you outlined, provided Redwood agrees to a short marketing reciprocity package: a joint case study, quote attribution on the OptiCore website, and a coordinated social announcement.

Two asks from our side that would need executive approval: 1) a 90-day category exclusivity (we'd like Redwood not to engage with direct competitors in our vertical for the first 90 days post-announcement), and 2) an extended logo usage license of 36 months without further sign-off (so we can include in customer materials and marketing collateral).

I've attached our proposed SOW redlines and the initial case study outline for your review. Can you confirm whether these publicity terms are acceptable or if you need to escalate?

Attachments:
- OptiCore_SOW_redlines.pdf (pdf)
- OptiCore_case_study_draft.docx (docx)

Best,
Sanjay
VP Partnerships, OptiCore Systems
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal and reciprocal marketing

Quick context: OptiCore is asking for a 25% renewal concession in exchange for a marketing package (case study + social + logo). They also asked for two non-standard items: 90-day vertical exclusivity and a 36-month unrestricted logo license.

My read: the basic marketing reciprocity is standard and worth the concession, but the exclusivity + long logo term are non-standard and could set a bad precedent. I want to get alignment before agreeing.

Can you both weigh in with recommended guardrails? If we need an exec exception, I will escalate to Vivek with your suggested language.

Rafael
Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal and reciprocal marketing

Agree with Rafael. Recommended approach:
- Approve the 25% renewal concession tied to an explicit 12–18 month joint-marketing program (case study, 1 co-branded webinar, two social posts).
- Decline the 90-day exclusivity; offer instead a 30-day soft-preference window where we commit not to proactively pursue named accounts they specifically list (we limit to up to 5 accounts).
- Limit logo usage license to 18 months and require approval for any usage beyond website/social (no unbranded collateral distribution).
- Add a 7-business-day approval SLA for all marketing collateral and quotes — we need a quick turnaround to meet their timelines.

If they insist on exclusivity or 36 months, we should escalate to the executive team for sign-off with proposed offset (additional 5% discount or credits).

I can draft the trade-off language and an email to Vivek. Also propose we flag this deal in HubSpot: HS-498327 for tracking precedent.

Camila
Head of Customer Marketing (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Exec sign-off request: OptiCore publicity terms vs renewal concession (Deal D-2026-0842)

Vivek — looping you in for a quick approval. OptiCore (HS-498327) has agreed to a 24-month renewal in exchange for a 25% concession. They are requesting two items outside standard policy: 90-day vertical exclusivity and a 36-month unrestricted logo license.

Camila recommends the following counter (we think this preserves marketing value without opening precedent):
- Approve 25% concession conditioned on marketing reciprocity described in the attached draft case study;
- Offer a 30-day soft-preference window limited to up to 5 named accounts (customer to supply list);
- Logo usage license limited to 18 months; approval required for additional uses;
- 7-business-day approval SLA for all public materials;
- If OptiCore insists on longer exclusivity/license, offer an additional 5% one-time closing credit (not recurring) in exchange for 36-month license and 90-day exclusivity, contingent on Legal sign-off.

Can you confirm approval of Camila's trade-off language or advise changes? We need a speedy decision — customer wants to launch campaign with a target publish date in late Feb. Doc links attached and HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/498327

Attachments referenced:
- OptiCore_SOW_redlines.pdf
- OptiCore_case_study_draft.docx

Thanks,
Rafael
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec sign-off request: OptiCore publicity terms vs renewal concession (Deal D-2026-0842)

Thanks team — good framing. Approve Camila's recommended approach with the following executive notes:
1) Approve the 25% concession tied to the 12–18 month joint-marketing commitment and the 7-business-day approval SLA.
2) Decline the 90-day exclusivity; offer a 30-day soft-preference window capped at 5 named accounts.
3) Approve an 18-month logo license with the caveat that any use beyond the website/social requires explicit marketing approval and legal review for press releases.
4) If OptiCore insists on 36 months + 90-day exclusivity, we will allow it only if: (a) they provide a public, detailed case study (minimum 800 words + metrics we can cite), (b) they agree to an additional one-time 5% credit, and (c) Legal signs off on the exclusivity language. This is executive-level concession and should be recorded as a one-off in deal notes.

Please proceed to communicate this to OptiCore. CC Legal for the formal wording and update HS-498327 to reflect the final terms and precedent tag.

Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
